LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N001_Text:
My name is Suiyin. I get some of the news from your side. It arrives late, and it is not always right.

More ratkin are on the roads. Some want food, some want to trade, and some will take what they can. Do not open the door because I wrote this. I am not vouching for them.

I will write again when there is more to say.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N002_Text:
{0} kinds of visitors have reached me now.

I keep arrival and settlement apart. Someone can come in well and leave badly. Someone can come to steal and still stay.

You do not need to write back. I will wait for the next report.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N003_Text:
The silver is mine. There are {0}.

I sent it the long way. The carrier complained that the load was too small, then asked when the next run would be. I have not promised him another.

The money is there. Use it for what you need now. You do not owe anyone a place because of it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Entry_Text:
The mother can barely stand. She pushes the child forward, then pulls the child back.

"Help my child."

She does not give her name. Everything she brought is beside the child.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004ChildAlone_Text:
The child stops where the basket used to be. The basket is gone. The boards were used somewhere else.

"Where is mother?"

The mood drop lasts a day. If the mind breaks today, the mark stays.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004FamilyHere_Text: The child finds the mother first. They do not say much.\n\nSuiyin writes one word: still here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Captive_Text: The child learned to look at the door before looking at people. Still alive, and treats staying alive as the day's work.\n\nSuiyin adds one short mark beside the name.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Story_Text: The room has been cleared. In a while, the map will not show what happened here.\n\nSuiyin does not write any more.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Banished_Text: You sent them past the border. The map has one less person to feed, and one less bed.\n\nA caravan may meet the survivor again within four years.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Revisit_Text: The caravan sees them on a road that should have been empty. The survivor can find food. The old cloth still has the colony's color.\n\nYou can leave them there. You can pay 250 silver and receive 2500 silver after four years. Killing them ends it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004RescuePaid_Text: The 250 silver is paid. The 2500 silver stays on the account for four years. Opening the save again does not start it over.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Killed_Text: Suiyin writes one line: "That is all."\n\nIt ends here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N004Regret_Text:
The mother still walks to the old place. The child is not there.

"If that day..."

She does not finish it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Accepted_Text: The child is with you. The trader checks the handover again.\n\nSomeone still has to feed the child and find a bed. That was not in the trade.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Cared_Text: Someone has had to stop work to watch the child. At least the crying no longer starts with a question about the name.\n\nThe old name is still there. Changing it is your business.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Dead_Text: The child did not live. The trade was already paid. Nobody is coming back to return it.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Left_Text: The child has left your care. What happens next is not known from here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Missing_Text: The handover was a while ago, and the child still has no settled place. This letter does not count the care as finished, and it does not count the child dead.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Rejected_Text: The trader packs the trade goods away. You do not change your answer, so he stops waiting.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005TimedOut_Text: The trader waits until the agreed time and gets no answer. He leaves with the child.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N005Broken_Text: The handover does not finish. The terms are void.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Entry_Text: The store is short a few mouthfuls. The hole at the wall is narrow, and crumbs hang at the edge.\n\nYou can seal it with 20 wood, leave bait, or clear the edge. Leave it for three days and the hole is gone.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Sealed_Text: The hole is filled. Today's count matches again.\n\nNobody goes to see who was on the other side.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006BaitSet_Text: Food is by the hole. Tonight there is one portion less. Check the trail after a day.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006BaitGone_Text: The bait is gone. There is a fresh trail outside. One more rain and it will be hard to read.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Traced_Text: You mark a place along the trail. Someone still has to walk there to see what is inside.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Stopped_Text: The trail stops here. The hole is closed, and it no longer takes food.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Cleaned_Text: You turn over the places around the hole where food could hide. The scraps come out, and they cannot be eaten.\n\nAt least nobody has to watch the gap tonight.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N006Gone_Text: When you look again, the hole is gone. That path cannot be followed.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Choice_Text: Some of these visitors have the plague. They are still here, and they cannot be handled like ordinary guests.\n\nYou can hold them for watch, let them go, or leave the choice for later. The disease does not stop because a choice was made. Joining, hiring, and trade still follow quarantine. Nobody gets well on their own.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Quarantine_Text: The sick stay for now. They still need care. A sentence telling them not to leave is not care.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Release_Text: You tell them to keep moving. Some move at once. Some have to wait until they can walk. The release ends when they actually leave.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Defer_Text: The sick stay as they are. The disease is still there, and the choice is still open.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Broken_Text: Someone still infected left the map. The rest are no longer held.\n\nWhere the ones who left went is not visible from here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Recovered_Text: The recovered people have left. This time they do not carry the plague with them. The same survivor can come back once, fifteen days later.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Stayed_Text: The recovered people stay in the colony. The sick beds are empty. They still need a place of their own.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007AllDead_Text: None of this group lived. The watch is over.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N007Return_Text: A known face is at the door. The plague was gone when they left.\n\nThey ask for a meal. You can receive them or send them on. A second person does not arrive in their place.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Arrive_Text:
"I came for the ones who are still alive."

{0} rearranges the words.

"We need food, and we need a road that still works. Six simple meals, and I leave the place of an old store. You can check whether I am telling it straight."

He will wait three days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Trade_Text: "That is enough. Do not add more. I cannot carry it."\n\n{0} hands over the place and checks the way back.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Proof_Text: "This part matches. I cannot promise the rest, and you do not have to believe it now."\n\n{0} finished records can be checked. The trade can still be made once.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008NoProof_Text: "I may have the wrong place."\n\nHe leaves. There is no fight, and no loss of trust.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Refuse_Text: "Then not. I still have to be outside before dark."\n\nA plain refusal does not cost trust.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Drive_Text: You drive the visitor off by force. That is recorded on its own. It does not become revenge by itself.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Dead_Text: The one who asked the way is dead. The message ends there.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Left_Text: The one who asked the way left the map. The message brought nothing back.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Missing_Text: The one who asked the way is missing. This letter does not call that death.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N008Timeout_Text: The three days are over. The visitor is still here, and the trade was not made.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Arrive_Text: There is no grain here. The box holds haul lists, ration counts, and damp paper.\n\nThe number on the top page was changed twice. The last change has no name. The place lasts fifteen days.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Take_Text: What can be carried is packed. Some pages are stuck together. Do not tear them yet.\n\nThe silver is {0}. While trust is positive, this payment is at most a quarter higher. It is paid once.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Leave_Text: You do not take the box. The place is noted. Whether the next group takes it is not decided here.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Hand_Text: "Leave one with us," the other says. "After you take the rest, do not make us ask again."\n\nThe records go to them. The silver is {0}.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Share_Text: You keep a copy. They keep the other. There is no silver now, and no promise that it comes back.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Destroy_Text: The paper and the box are no longer usable. There is no second copy here to check the list against.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_N009Empty_Text: The place is still there. What could be taken is already gone. The walk brought nothing back.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Journal_Text: This batch is recorded. A broad relief counts only after a safe leaving or continued settlement. The same batch is not counted twice.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_1_Text: Someone is talking about a child's place again. The last time does not decide this one.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_2_Text: The grain trail has another place. Do not treat them as the same until someone walks there.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_3_Text: Someone can travel again, so news can arrive again. Whether this visitor heard about the quarantine still has to be asked.
LanguageData.RHAH_Suiyin_Aside_4_Text: The place he named is there. This time, the thing he promised is actually in it.
